newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG ups Gdanski stake to 63 pct.
newsitem.headline: BIG ups Gdanski stake to 63 pct.

text.p: Polish Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) bought 6,260,240 shares, or 31.9 percent in Bank Gdanski from the state treasury on Monday, increasing its stake to 63.4 percent in Gdanski, BIG's spokesman said.
Wojciech Kaczorowski told Reuters the shares were bought on kerb at 40 zlotys per share.
"The transaction has been concluded as BIG bought the shares in Bank Gdanski in a kerb transaction," he said.
BIG, which holds Gdanski directly and through two subsidiaries and was the only bidder for the treasury stake, on Friday said it had agreed to buy more shares at 40 zlotys.
The Bank of New York as a depositary bank currently holds 19.5 percent of Gdanski's shares, represented by the bank's GDRs held by foreign investors.
The treasury plans to hold on to about five percent of Gdanski shares.
Small investors on the Warsaw bourse hold the remaining shares. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
